title: The Industry-Standard Benchmark Demo: HTML5 Water Simulation
prompt: Build a highly polished, interactive 2D water particle simulation using HTML5 Canvas and vanilla JavaScript. Liquid particles should fall from the top, collide with adjustable sliders/obstacles, pool at the bottom with realistic fluid density, and ripple when clicked. Pack everything—CSS styling, HTML structure, and the complete physics math loop—into a single, production-grade index.html file.
validation_criteria: HTML5 Canvas element rendering via getContext('2d')
Fluid density / pooling behavior at container bottom
Adjustable sliders or interactive collision obstacles
Mouse click or pointer drag ripple propagation
Self-contained single index.html file with embedded CSS and JS
